title: Subscription-Box Value Check
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=delivery:parcel type=subscription_box
| stats avg(order_value) as paid, avg(contents_value) as received, count as boxes by service
| eval value_ratio=round(received/paid,2)
| sort value_ratio
description: Compares what each subscription box costs against the value of what it contains, exposing the poor-value ones.
value: Subscription boxes drift from delightful to wasteful; a value ratio tells you which to keep and which to cancel.
implementation: Log box cost and estimated contents value into `index=personal`; review the value ratio per service.
visualization: Bar chart of value ratio by subscription box.
grandmaExplanation: It compares what each subscription box costs with what is inside, showing which are worth keeping.
